done_when: Close starts the review at the same time as its tests, so a round takes about as long as the slower of the two; a red test or a P0/P1 finding still stops the round, and both results are reported together. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body: Raise: Functional. If tests and a P0/P1 review both fail, then the same tests pass on a later `forge close` without a branch change, the saved review still blocks the round, but this line sets the item to `waiting for checks`. The later serious-finding refusal does not correct that status. The board shows “Checks running” (`src/forge/board.py:48`), and `forge next` directs the worker to run close again instead of fixing the finding (`src/forge/nextstep.py:53-54`).
findings.title: A blocked review is shown as waiting for checks when its tests pass on retry

stop.reason: Owner chose one more round: update the older test that expects the test result inside the review prompt to the new behaviour; no other change

why: Close waits for tests to finish before it starts the review
